## Scope Note (CRITICAL)

The captured UI shows **CP's OWN self-KYC form** (Firm Details, Contact Details, Additional Details, KYC Document Upload), not buyer/customer KYC on behalf of an allocated customer.

Per FSD-CORRECTION 2026-05-25 (FRD Section 1.2):
> "CP self-KYC only (`POST /cp/registration` — unauthenticated). The WINNER-prerequisite and buyer-KYC-on-behalf described below do NOT correspond to any implemented backend endpoint."

TC scenarios below reflect the live UI (CP self-KYC). Legacy customer-KYC flow described in older BRD/FRD sections is treated as deprecated / not applicable to the live `/kyc` route.

**Status (v2 — 2026-06-07):** 11 stale TCs regenerated against corrected BRD (`type=text` email/phone, disabled-Submit gating, 3 documents). 7 new gap-coverage TCs added (Business Region MMR/Pune/BGLR, Submit enable-transition, KYC Document Upload section header, GST upload, MAHA RERA upload). 3 deprecated rows moved to bottom section (TC_CPKYC_FUNC_020, TC_CPKYC_FUNC_022, TC_CPKYC_NEG_018 — superseded by post-correction TCs).
